_comment: Accounts NoiseAreaStrategy runs on, read by review_all.py, the scheduled routines and the strategy's own start checks (2026-10-21). contracts = the micros the account is registered for. A Bulenox Qualification adds eval (25K/50K/100K/150K, Option 2) and eval_start (purchase or last reset date, YYYY-MM-DD). A funded Bulenox Master adds master: true and (2026-10-30, Master Account Agreement: a trade at least every 5 trading days) activity_after: 3 - the strategy's 'Activity after N dry sessions' must equal it or it refuses to start; activity_vm (default 0) is its band multiplier. Sim101 has neither. chandelier = the chandelier exit the account's strategy must run (x ATR(14); 2026-10-30: 3 on Sim101 at Sashkin's decision - research\CHVAL_RESULTS.txt is the verdict against it; 0 = the validated rules) - 'Chandelier exit (x ATR)' must equal it or the strategy refuses to start, and the review recomputes decisions with it. Only Claude edits this file, from Sashkin's own statement of what he bought.
